Add and subtract · Multiply · Divide

by Hasan

Thursday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can add and subtract decimals by lining up the points

✓ I can multiply decimals (grid and column)

✓ I can divide decimals with the bus stop

So you can check a receipt, split a bill and get your change right!

🔍 Spot the mistake

Is the student right? Find the mistake. Chat first, then click!

1

Ali: "3.4 + 1.25 = 1.59."

✗ Points not lined up.

✓ 3.40 + 1.25 = 4.65

2

Bo: "6 − 2.3 = 4.3."

✗ Did 6 − 2, kept the .3

✓ 6.0 − 2.3 = 3.7

3

Cal: "0.7 + 0.5 = 0.12."

✗ 7 tenths + 5 tenths = 12 tenths

✓ 1.2

Line up the points. Fill with 0s.
